mdcalc_source: https://www.mdcalc.com/calc/1739/revised-cardiac-risk-index-preoperative-risk (the requested /calc/1745/ URL returned 404; same RCRI calculator found via search)
mdcalc_rules: 6 criteria, +1 each (0-6): elevated-risk surgery (intraperitoneal, intrathoracic, or suprainguinal vascular); history of ischemic heart disease (MI, positive exercise test, current ischemic chest pain, nitrate use, or ECG pathological Q waves); history of CHF (pulmonary edema, bilateral rales or S3 gallop, PND, CXR pulmonary vascular redistribution); history of cerebrovascular disease (prior TIA or stroke); pre-operative insulin treatment; pre-operative creatinine >2 mg/dL (>176.8 umol/L).

code_vs_mdcalc.issue: None found. Code adds +1 per boolean criterion, creatinine strictly >2 mg/dL (2.0 scores 0, matching MDCalc), umol/L converted with MW 113.12 (equivalent to /88.4), missing criteria default to absent. Age is in name_to_python but unused, which is correct for RCRI.

items.details: congestive_heart_failure stored False, should be True. Note documents a diagnosis of CHF on furosemide; RCRI/MDCalc criterion is 'History of congestive heart failure'. The near-identical note in row 243 (same text) and row 260 ('well-managed CHF', euvolemic) are both stored True, so row 241 is internally inconsistent. Correct: IHD(+1, angina/nitroglycerin) + CHF(+1) + CVD(+1, ischemic stroke) + Cr 2.1 >2 (+1); breast biopsy not elevated-risk = 4. (A prior audit, entities_rcrifix.csv, also flagged CHF as omitted.)
